diagnosis: Progress has stalled because the incumbent is a deeply jammed LP vertex: about 545 pairs sit at slack $\sim10^{-12}$ from the maximum, so the $8.16\times10^{-7}$ total gain is merely equalisation/squeezing of the original basin rather than discovery of a better one. Its contact graph is highly irregular, averaging $2\cdot545/116\approx9.4$ contacts per point but ranging from 2 to 19, with overloaded hubs, near-floppy points, no rattlers, and an amorphous projected graph. With $116\cdot5-15=565$ rotationally-reduced degrees of freedom, 545 active contacts nearly exhaust all motion, while the next pair shell is only $\sim10^{-4}$ behind, so any null-space move immediately creates new blockers. The missing structural property is therefore a balanced, positively-spanning, force-balanced near-isostatic contact network—ideally arising from a discrete/symmetric distance shell—rather than a glassy plateau in which many equalised contacts must carry near-zero KKT weight while low-degree points are not locally jammed in their 5D tangent spaces.
